source_inventory_method: Independent Python stdlib text registration inventory and manually reviewed loop expansion; no JavaScript evaluation. The retained inventory binds every ordered name to its original file/line, addition status, and original historical TAP case and exact duration where applicable.

historical_timing_context.budget_rationale: The 173 matched retained original case durations total 14913.288587 ms. Round this to 15 s for historical case work; allow 20 s for 35 new cases and changed assertions, plus 20 s for startup, module loading, filesystem and host variability. Send TERM at 55 s from the project launch attempt and KILL at 60 s if still active. A separate maximum 5 s wait after KILL only reaps the already-signaled process; it does not authorize further work or any retry. Each of the two identity calls has its own 10 s deadline and immediate KILL on timeout, followed by the same bounded reap. Preserve every assertion and original selected source file.

scope: ONE original-file Node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap invocation of these nine files only, after exactly two pinned Node identity calls. No imports, syntax checks, build, browser, scanner, native, physical, copied implementation, adversarial reproduction, rerun, or expanded selection is authorized by these unexecuted controls.
expected_index_flags: H for every path; no skip-worktree or assume-unchanged flags
